decisions.text: Decided 2026-09-18: the user picks Quick or Full scan (neither is marked recommended; Return presses Quick because it needs nothing). Not set up = hollow amber ring, never red. Open at login defaults on; the history guard defaults off because it edits ~/.zshrc. Native material everywhere, state colours only on the mark, dots and the progress bar.
